style.backgroundSystem: one seamless studio sweep cyclorama in #F8E3DA falling to #F0D5CB in a soft vertical gradient at the lower third, with two or three floating translucent rings (thin #58294A outlines, #FDF6F2 fill at about 12% opacity) drifting behind the product; depth stays shallow, abstract and studio-only; copy fields sit on #FDF6F2 panels outlined with a #58294A hairline; section rules are a single row of thin plum circle-and-pip markers; never an arch panel, never stacked plinth blocks, never a wave band, never a nursery floor mat, never a grass or domestic room field, never a cloud or sea horizon

style.iconSystem: a thin #58294A circle outline at 1.5pt carrying one centred solid pip dot in #B25E7E, used as bullet, step marker, row anchor and callout head, always one circle per short label on one baseline; hairline #58294A leader lines only; flat single-weight, no fill gradient; no leaf pips, no feather, no shield, no droplet, no cloud pictogram, no solid colour tiles, no pill capsules, no 3D icons, no cartoon illustration

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent soft high-key peach-and-plum studio care ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless sweep #F8E3DA falloff #F0D5CB, card stock #FDF6F2, warm grey sub-text #8A7E79, matte anchor strip #CFC4BE, deep plum headline and hairline #58294A with one single accent pip #B25E7E; neutral overall temperature; bright 5800K high-key soft key from the upper front-left with a gentle gradient falloff and one true contact shadow under every resting object, never flat wrap, never warm low sun; background is one seamless studio sweep with two or three floating translucent thin-outlined rings, never an arch panel, never stacked plinths, never a wave band, never a domestic floor field; one modern geometric Chinese sans display family plus one light geometric sans, headline type in #58294A, subline in #8A7E79, labels in #58294A inside thin square hairline frames, all Chinese copy wrapped in 「」 and supplied as placeholders; icon language is a thin #58294A circle carrying one centred #B25E7E pip, used identically on every screen; the flat rectangular pad keeps its own corner radius, folded bound edge, quilting pitch and backing colour, the matte fibrous touch face and the smooth low-sheen backing film always rendered as two different materials, the pack silhouette unchanged with its print panel blank, never re-tinted, never floating, never cropped at the base, one real scale anchor in every scene frame, and no person, baby, hand or change in progress anywhere; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented claims or figures.

no mixed fonts, no capsule pill labels and no rounded bubble type

style.presentationRules: the pad is the only hero and keeps its identity on every screen: flat rectangular sheet, its own corner radius, folded bound edge, quilting pitch and proportions, never re-tinted and never restyled, never shown as a worn garment; the pack shell keeps its original silhouette, handle cut-out and panel placement with the print panel left blank; shown flat, folded, fanned or in macro, always grounded by a true contact shadow, never floating, never cropped at the resting edge; verticals stay vertical; the matte face and the film backing are always rendered as two different materials; one real scale anchor (the #CFC4BE strip, a textile fold, a tote edge) appears in every scene frame; no person of any kind appears, and no infant, baby face, caregiver hand or change in progress is ever shown
style.surfaceSystem: the #F8E3DA sweep continues into the floor; a folded matte textile in #E7E2DF and a thin #CFC4BE matte board strip are the only stages and the only scale anchors; #FDF6F2 matte card stock for copy panels; the product keeps its own finishes, the touch face reading as a matte fibrous nonwoven with a visible embossed quilting pitch and the backing reading as a smooth sheet with a low specular sheen, the two never rendered alike and never as plastic gloss or as paper
style.typography: one modern geometric Chinese sans display family for headlines plus one light geometric sans for body and labels; headline type in #58294A at 26-42pt, subline in #8A7E79 at 14-18pt, label type in #58294A at 10-14pt inside thin square hairline frames; a small letter-spaced Latin kicker above each headline; identical hierarchy, sizes and hairline weights on every screen; all Chinese copy supplied as placeholders wrapped in 「」; no rounded bubble lettering, no capsule pill labels, no serif, no handwriting
